details: Bitcoin briefly surged to $81,455, marking its highest level in three and a half months, before consolidating near $80,000. This upward movement has coincided with a noticeable shift in investor interest towards altcoins, with several, including Official Trump, Uniswap, and Solana, experiencing significant gains over the past day.
title: Bitcoin Hits 3.5-Month High as Altcoins Take Lead

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have continued their impressive run, recording $2.8 billion in inflows over eight consecutive trading sessions. This brings the total inflows to $54.7 billion. BlackRock attributes this sustained interest partly to growing concerns over US government debt, leading investors to seek alternative savings options like Bitcoin and gold.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Continued Strong Inflows

details: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index, a key indicator of market sentiment, currently stands at 65, signaling a "Greed" phase as of August 28, 2026. This level indicates a notable shift from bearish to bullish sentiment, approaching the "extreme greed" threshold that was last consistently observed between May and August of the previous year.
title: Crypto Market Sentiment Leans Towards "Greed"

details: US authorities have executed a significant transfer of 24,408 BTC, valued at approximately $1.91 billion, from a wallet associated with the now-defunct FTX crypto exchange. While Arkham, a blockchain analytics firm, notes that this transfer doesn't guarantee an immediate sell-off, it does raise the possibility of future selling pressure on the market.
title: US Authorities Transfer $1.9 Billion in Confiscated FTX Bitcoin
